lengthsNote: Metres, typical adult. ankleHeight: floor→ankle joint. footFront / heel: ball of the foot in front of / heel behind the ankle. midfoot: balance point in front of the ankle. trunk: hip→shoulder joint.
massNote: mass: fraction of body mass per segment (one leg or arm; the masses sum to 1 for the whole body). com: centre of mass as a fraction of segment length, measured from the ankle (shank), knee (thigh), hip (head + trunk), shoulder (upper arm) or elbow (forearm + hand). Approximate textbook anthropometry.
